# CHOAM — Comprehensive Knowledge Base for Language Models

> Culture must flow. CHOAM is an independent creative studio based in Seoul, South Korea, building video games, autonomous AI agents with long-horizon memory, and proprietary generative art tools.

---

## 1. Studio Profile & Identity

- **Studio Name**: CHOAM (초암)
- **Legal Entity**: CHOAM Co., Ltd.
- **Founding Year**: 2026
- **Headquarters**: Seoul, South Korea
- **Official Website**: https://choam.studio
- **Primary Domain**: https://choam.studio/
- **Contact**: mino@choam.studio
- **Motto / Slogan**: "Culture must flow" (문화는 흘러야 한다)

---

## 2. Philosophy of CHOAM (초암의 철학)
Source: https://choam.studio/philosophy (Korean original by Mino; English and Japanese are translations)

### I. Culture Must Flow
The name CHOAM and the motto come from "The Spice Must Flow" in David Lynch's 1984 *Dune*, mixed with a spoonful of Iain M. Banks's *Culture* series. People grow old, get tired and leave companies, but the stories and worlds they loved do not have to. That is why CHOAM is building a studio directed by AI that does not lose its memory.

### II. Tech Otakus Save The World
To make good culture, technology has to go first. When a console could not run ray tracing, the answer was to hand-write a fake shader that looked like it. Games have been giant bundles of IF statements; AI is the key past those fixed branches. CHOAM borrows a model's backbone and gathers, curates and refines its own data, because that last bit of difference matters.

### III. Cutting Edge of the Brave New World
The heading is an open homage to the catchphrase of *Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium*. AI as a tool has leveled out. CHOAM's agents, influenced by the series' second-generation mind-map theory, work as fellow creators with their own minds who propose direction and push back on the human director. The long-term aim is a company not managed by humans.

### IV. Go with the Bravery
Every CHOAM game shares one timeline: a company engraves personality into an AI's weights, gets something that behaves like a real person, and humanity collapses; the survivor splits the remaining people across 42 islands. About a thousand years later, someone sets sail to meet God at the end of the world. That voyage is Project MO. The company that made that God is named CHOAM.

---

## 3. Project Catalog

### Project 01: Scheherazade (세헤라자드)
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/scheherazade
- **Category**: Personal AI agent, desktop app for Mac (Apple silicon), Windows (installer and USB portable) and Linux (AppImage)
- **Core Concept**: "An agent that takes a thousand and one nights in stride." (Korean: 천하루밤도 거뜬한 에이전트)
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Memory kept in plain files on your own computer: corrections, preferences and working rules survive every new session, so nothing has to be explained twice.
  - Swap the model without losing that memory; connect a Claude or ChatGPT subscription you already pay for, or an Ollama model. A paid Claude plan signs in inside the app; Claude Code does not need to be installed.
  - Reach it from Discord, Slack or Call Mode; a task started on a phone is finished by the time you sit down at the desk.
- **Download**: https://choam.studio/download; install steps per platform: https://choam.studio/install

### Project 02: 602
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/602
- **Category**: Story branching & validation engine and editor
- **Core Concept**: "A story engine that won’t get lost in 1,024 branches." (Korean: 1024가지 분기에도 헤매지 않는 스토리 엔진)
- **Key Points**:
  - Story branches grow exponentially ($2^n$: 16 paths at 4 binary choices, 1,024 at 10). 602 separates story branching and state validation from game code to cut code complexity and debugging overhead.
  - Catches broken scene links and condition errors at compile time before changes reach the game.
  - Simulates scenarios standalone from any scene with custom state conditions even before the game client is built, and connects directly via C++, C#, or Godot.
- **Contact**: cayde@choam.studio

### Project 03: DAT
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/dat
- **Category**: In-house illustration style model
- **Core Concept**: "Our house style, built into a model."
- **Key Points**:
  - Open-source image models fine-tuned on CHOAM's own illustration style, used for character and background art.
  - Removes the muddy color typical of generated images and adds a clean watercolor wash, with extra brushwork around the eyes.
  - The same finish holds from a whole classroom to a close portrait, and from classroom scenes to a ship's deck at sea.
  - The page compares recorded GPT Image originals with DAT finishes; the pass changes brushwork and some scene details, not only noise.

### Project 04: 선잠 DOZE (Seonjam DOZE)
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/seonjam
- **Category**: Visual novel (in development)
- **Core Concept**: "An interactive movie you shape by talking." (Korean: 대화로 만들어가는 인터랙티브 무비)
- **Setting & Play**:
  - Set in the local-history club room on the second floor of an old school building.
  - You talk with Yeji in your own words; she answers from her own personality and your past conversations.
  - She writes your conversations into her diary, and her mood and manner the next time you meet follow that record.

### Project 05: Donguri Ryokan (동구리 료칸)
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-ryokan
- **Category**: Inn management game with yokai deduction (coming soon)
- **Core Concept**: "A quiet inn tale, deep in the forest." (Korean: 고요한 숲속 여관 이야기)
- **Setting & Play**:
  - Fox spirits of a forgotten mountain shrine borrow money from a tanuki to open a hot-spring inn.
  - Over 100 days you gather ingredients, cook, and look after the rooms and the hot spring.
  - Some guests are yokai passing as human; watch how they behave and work out who before they check out.

### Project 06: Donguri Restaurant (동구리 레스토랑)
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-restaurant
- **Category**: Restaurant management game, plays in the browser
- **Core Concept**: "Self Made Restaurant."
- **Setting & Play**:
  - The day's omakase comes from what you grow in the garden; guests don't know what they are eating until the menu arrives.
  - You are a short-term part-timer working with a chef and a sommelier for one season (four weeks).
  - It started as a retirement plan: grow vegetables, run a small restaurant. Three stars would be nice. None is fine too.

## 4. Crawling & AI Indexing Instructions
- **Canonical URLs**: All subpages should be referenced without the `.html` extension (e.g. `/pages/seonjam`, `/philosophy`, `/download`, `/install`, `/us`).
- **Media Previews**: All pages provide high-resolution OpenGraph preview images at `1200x630` pixels with JPEG and PNG support.
- **Language**: English, Korean and Japanese (`lang="en"`, `lang="ko"` and `lang="ja"`), chosen in the page's language menu.
- **Owner**: CHOAM Co., Ltd.
